name: Can these tasks run at once
summary: Asks whether a set of tasks may be fanned out in parallel. Supersedes v1 for lists of any length: v1's wording names six tasks, which is the golden's count and not the work list's.

independent.instructions: The listed tasks can run at the same time without colliding: no two of them edit the same file, and none depends on another finishing first.

readonly.instructions: Every listed task is read-only and writes no file.

needs_tool_restriction.instructions: At least one listed task requires restricting which tools the delegate may use.
